project.description: Auto-mock candidates are keyed by target type plus qualifiers, and the two collection paths disagree on what a plain @Inject means: ProcessInjectionPoint reports CDI's normalized set, in which no declared qualifier is @Default, while the test class's fields are walked reflectively and yield the empty set. The keys differ, so the same unqualified unsatisfied type injected into an application bean and into the test class registers two @Default beans and the container refuses the deployment - AmbiguousResolutionException on OpenWebBeans, WELD-001409 on Weld. An explicitly qualified injection is unaffected, because then both paths see the same annotation. This scenario pins the current limitation rather than endorsing it, so that a fix is a deliberate change to a failing assertion instead of a silent behaviour shift. The documented way to hold a reference to a collaborator is a @TestBean static field (scenario 65).
project.name: jawelte tests/cdi-module scenario 64: a type injected into both an application bean and the test class stays ambiguous
